class.name: SignallingImplementation
class.brief_description: Interface of a signalling system's behaviour: its state machine, implemented in C++ or GDScript.
class.description: A system is always the same [SignallingServer] object; what differs between signalling systems - the original's scenery events, an automatic block, an interlocking - is its implementation: its state machine and the vocabulary of its aspects. Override the virtual methods in GDScript or C++. Every callback carries the system: a Resource is shared by default, so one implementation may serve several systems and keeps its state per system RID. An implementation drives the lights, the routes' state and the switches only through the servers' API.

method.name: _handle_event
method.description: A command to the system as a whole: [method SignallingServer.system_send_event] - a script, a dispatcher, a scenery event, a linked system.

method.name: _handle_source_event
method.description: A report of one of the system's sources: [method SignallingServer.source_send_event]. A sensor's passage is the [code]"impulse"[/code] event with [code]{"polarity": SignallingServer.SourcePolarity}[/code]. An isolated section's source ([method SignallingServer.source_set_isolated]) sends [code]"occupied"[/code] and [code]"freed"[/code] with no arguments.

method.name: _route_added
method.description: The route joined the system - also every route the system already holds, when the implementation is attached.

method.name: _route_cancel_requested
method.description: The route is asked to be cancelled before the train is let onto it ([method SignallingServer.route_request_cancel]).

method.name: _route_emergency_release_requested
method.description: The route is asked to be released at once ([method SignallingServer.route_request_emergency_release]); the release is to be recorded.

method.name: _route_release_requested
method.description: The route is asked to be released by hand, with the delay its kind has ([method SignallingServer.route_request_release]).

method.name: _route_removed
method.description: The route left the system.

method.name: _route_set_requested
method.description: The route is asked to be set ([method SignallingServer.route_request_set]). The implementation checks it, moves its switches through [TrackServer] and moves its state with [method SignallingServer.route_set_state].

method.name: _signal_head_added
method.description: The signal head joined the system - also every signal head the system already holds, when the implementation is attached.

method.name: _signal_head_aspect_changed
method.description: One of the system's signal heads now shows [param aspect] ([method SignallingServer.signal_head_set_aspect]).

method.name: _signal_head_removed
method.description: The signal head left the system.

method.name: _source_added
method.description: The source joined the system - also every source the system already holds, when the implementation is attached.

method.name: _source_removed
method.description: The source left the system.

method.name: _switch_added
method.description: The switch of the name joined the system - whether [TrackServer] has it yet or not; also every switch the system already holds, when the implementation is attached.

method.name: _switch_created
method.description: [TrackServer] created the system's switch of the name: its track became a switch.

method.name: _switch_freed
method.description: [TrackServer] freed the system's switch of the name: its track became another type or was freed. The system has no control of it any more.

method.name: _switch_movement_finished
method.description: The system's switch of the name came to lie on [param active_track] ([enum TrackServer.SwitchTrack]).

method.name: _switch_removed
method.description: The switch of the name left the system.

method.name: _system_attached
method.description: The implementation was attached to the system; the system's elements follow, each with its own callback.

method.name: _system_detached
method.description: The implementation was detached from the system, or the system freed.

method.name: _system_linked
method.description: The system was linked to [param other] ([method SignallingServer.system_link]); also every linked system, when the implementation is attached.

method.name: _system_unlinked
method.description: The link of the system to [param other] was removed.
